intents.action_domain: switch the interface language via the header dropdown
intents.outcome: the whole page renders in the chosen locale (vi | en) and the choice persists

justification: One user-facing intent. The task is the MoMorph 'Dropdown-ngôn ngữ' frame (hUyaaugye2), which specs a single control: the open language list with its two rows. No conjunction smell-flag fires on the raw task text ('Implement the language dropdown'), and enumeration yields exactly one (actor, action-domain, outcome) triple. This revises the already-implemented F005_LanguageSwitching rather than introducing a new capability, so the existing fcode is reused.
